vocabulary_source.fit_scope: frozen train actions and pinned transition grammar; validation metrics only; test content closed

candidate_variant.formula: query = Linear(hidden_size, rank, bias=False); logits = query @ class_embeddings.T + class_bias
candidate_variant.training_candidates: Grammar root/child candidates derived from the decoder prefix before each teacher action; terminalizable kinds only.
candidate_variant.inference_candidates: Existing runtime root/child grammar mask, including terminalizable kinds; the scorer logits and candidate identities are unchanged.
candidate_variant.failure_hypothesis: Sparse node-kind labels are learned with an independent 128-dimensional classifier per class; low-rank class factors reduce independent output parameters and the legal candidate set narrows each decision.
candidate_variant.expected_observation: Improved supported-class macro-F1/calibration or equal quality with fewer independent head parameters; parser/executable outcomes must also improve to retain the variant.

budget_target.minimum_source: TreeCompletionBudget.minimum_root_nodes() from the pinned parser schema and frozen transition grammar
budget_target.inference: Map residual scores to absolute totals starting at the certified minimum; mask every lower total to negative infinity.
budget_target.contract: Both train and inference require a per-example minimum computed without target AST/node count.

excluded_hypotheses.edge_field: Deferred: runtime predicts a parent before masking edge fields, while teacher edge decisions do not expose a predicted parent. A faithful legal training mask requires joint parent-edge scoring; target-parent conditioning would leak the gold parent.
excluded_hypotheses.node_budget: Enabled only with a parser-schema-certified minimum root completion and a learned residual; reject missing minima and targets below the floor. Do not derive a budget floor from the target tree.
excluded_hypotheses.loss_weighting: No blanket inverse-frequency weighting; per-class support remains reported and the matched screen changes only the registered head mechanism.

screen_contract.control_and_variant: same backbone, initialization seed, data order, optimizer, steps, grammar, decode budget, and free-running evaluator
screen_contract.candidate_mask: same grammar legality at training and inference for node_kind; empty sets and illegal targets fail closed
metrics: per-class support, recall, macro-F1 and calibration
legal candidate-set size and masked/unmasked accuracy
executable outcomes only if a frozen bounded invocation/expected-output contract exists
screen_contract.gpu: one registered seed after WP-078-B implementation preflight passes; no capability promotion
screen_contract.negative_result: Retain the legacy head and stop this branch if free-running executable outcomes do not improve.

strict_ast_gate: unchanged and separate; the current historical result remains 0/60 strict-passed
